news.title: In the clouds
news.summary_en: Under a new grant from the NSF, a WashU team will use AI and statistics to study the impact of aerosols on marine low clouds. That knowledge can help communities protect health and prepare for extreme weather.

news.title: Immune cell map uncovers how individual aging trajectories diverge
news.summary_en: WashU Medicine researchers have discovered that the ratio between two types of white blood cells can predict whether a person stays healthy as they age or faces an increased risk of disease.

news.title: WashU seeks Carnegie Classification for Community Engagement
news.summary_en: WashU will assess its partnerships, teaching, research and service to the community in a quest to earn the Carnegie Classification for Community Engagement. A kickoff event is scheduled for Oct. 21 as part of WashU’s inaugural Community Engagement Week.
